title: 「Parenthetical Insertion 句」
titleEn: Using a parenthetical sentence adverb after the subject

omissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

formula: Complete subject + , + sentence adverb + , + verb / predicate

formulas.formula: Complete subject + , + sentence adverb + , + verb / predicate

exampleZh: 這份提案，坦白說，不切實際。

examples.zh: 這份提案，坦白說，不切實際。

rules.zh: 把副詞放在完整主語之後 先寫完整的主語，再加入副詞。 surprisingly 不可以插入 the new software 這個完整名詞組之中。
rules.en: Place the sentence adverb after the complete subject. Write the full subject first; do not insert surprisingly inside the complete noun phrase the new software.
examples: The new software, surprisingly, works very well.

rules.zh: 副詞前後都要使用逗號 在本課所學的 parenthetical insertion 句型中，副詞屬於插入資料，因此前後都要加上逗號。
rules.en: Put a comma before and after the inserted adverb because it is parenthetical information in this target pattern.
examples: The exam, fortunately, was not difficult.

rules.zh: 使用能評論整句內容的句子副詞 常用句子副詞包括： 表達坦白或個人態度 ● honestly：老實說 ● frankly：坦白說 ● admittedly：無可否認 表達好事或壞事 ● fortunately：幸好 ● thankfully：幸好；令人欣慰地 ● unfortunately：很可惜 ● regrettably：令人遺憾地 ● luckily：幸好 表達意外或預期 ● surprisingly：令人意外地 ● unexpectedly：出乎意料地 ● understandably：可以理解地 表達肯定或不確定 ● clearly：很明顯 ● obviously：顯然 ● apparently：看來；據說 ● perhaps：也許 表達最終結果 ● ultimately：最終 ● eventually：最後；終於
rules.en: Use a sentence adverb that comments on the whole statement. Common choices include attitude adverbs such as honestly, frankly and admittedly; positive or negative reactions such as fortunately, thankfully, unfortunately, regrettably and luckily; surprise or expectation markers such as surprisingly, unexpectedly and understandably; certainty markers such as clearly, obviously, apparently and perhaps; and result markers such as ultimately and eventually.

rules.zh: 不要把句子副詞與方式副詞混淆 句子副詞評論的是整句內容。 這裏的 honestly 表示說話者正在坦白表達自己的看法。 方式副詞只描述一個動作如何進行。 這裏的 honestly 只描述經理回答問題的方式，因此不屬於本課的 parenthetical insertion。
rules.en: Do not confuse sentence adverbs with adverbs of manner. A sentence adverb comments on the whole statement; in the parenthetical example, honestly signals that the speaker is frankly stating an opinion. An adverb of manner describes only how an action is performed; honestly in the second example describes how the manager answered and is therefore not the parenthetical insertion practised here.
examples: The manager, honestly, did not know the answer.

rules.zh: 長主語後才加入副詞 如果主語包含介詞片語或關係子句，必須等完整主語結束後才加入副詞。 完整主語是：
rules.en: With a long subject containing a prepositional phrase or relative clause, insert the adverb only after the full subject has ended.
examples: Daniel, who arrived last, surprisingly, gave the strongest answer.

rules.zh: 副詞必須符合原句意思 ● fortunately 不可用來描述壞結果。 ● unfortunately 不可用來描述好結果。 ● apparently 表示事情看來是真的，但說話者並不完全確定。 ● admittedly 通常表示說話者願意承認某個事實。 ● frankly 和 honestly 通常用來直接表達個人看法。
rules.en: Choose an adverb that matches the intended meaning. Fortunately cannot describe a bad result, and unfortunately cannot describe a good one. Apparently suggests that something seems true but remains uncertain; admittedly signals willingness to acknowledge a fact; and frankly or honestly normally introduces a direct personal view.
examples: fortunately 不可用來描述壞結果。
unfortunately 不可用來描述好結果。
apparently 表示事情看來是真的，但說話者並不完全確定。
admittedly 通常表示說話者願意承認某個事實。
frankly 和 honestly 通常用來直接表達個人看法。

rules.zh: 不要過度使用這個句型 Parenthetical insertion 能增加語氣和句式變化，但每一句都加入插入副詞，會令文章顯得斷續。 應在需要表達態度、反應或判斷時才使用。
rules.en: Do not overuse parenthetical insertion. It can vary tone and sentence structure, but inserting an adverb into every sentence makes writing feel broken up; use it when an attitude, reaction or judgement needs to be expressed.

benefits.zh: 先提出主題，再加入個人態度 這個句型先讓讀者知道句子正在談論甚麼，再補充說話者的態度。 第二句先提出 the proposal，再插入 frankly，因此能把「提案」保持為句子的主要焦點。
benefits.en: It states the topic before adding the speaker’s attitude. In the comparison, placing the proposal first and inserting frankly afterwards keeps the proposal as the main focus.

benefits.zh: 把事實和評論放在同一句中 你不需要另外寫一句來表達自己的反應。 這個句型能在交代事實的同時，加入「可惜」、「幸好」或「令人意外」等評論。
benefits.en: It combines a fact and a comment in one sentence, allowing you to report information while adding a reaction such as regret, relief or surprise instead of writing a separate comment sentence.

benefits.zh: 更準確地表達語氣 不同副詞可以表達不同程度的肯定和不同情緒。 ● clearly 表示證據明顯。 ● apparently 表示事情看來是真的，但仍有不確定性。 ● perhaps 表示可能性。 ● thankfully 表示說話者對結果感到欣慰。 讀者可以立即理解說話者對內容的立場。
benefits.en: It expresses tone more precisely. Different adverbs convey different degrees of certainty and emotion: clearly points to evident proof, apparently retains uncertainty, perhaps signals possibility, and thankfully conveys relief. Readers can therefore identify the speaker’s stance immediately.
examples: apparently 表示事情看來是真的，但仍有不確定性。
thankfully 表示說話者對結果感到欣慰。

benefits.zh: 增加句式變化 學生經常把副詞放在句首： 使用 parenthetical insertion 後，可以改為： 這讓文章不會連續出現相同的句子開頭。
benefits.en: It adds sentence variety by moving an adverb from the beginning into a parenthetical position and avoiding a run of identical sentence openings.

benefits.zh: 讓說話更有自然停頓 在口語中，插入副詞形成一個短暫停頓，讓說話者可以補充態度或反應。 這種停頓適合用於討論、簡報、會議及日常對話。
benefits.en: It creates a natural pause in speech during which the speaker can add an attitude or reaction. This is useful in discussions, presentations, meetings and everyday conversation.

benefits.zh: 幫助控制表達的直接程度 frankly 和 honestly 可以表明你正在直接表達看法；apparently 和 perhaps 則可以令說 法較審慎。 語氣直接。 語氣較審慎。
benefits.en: It helps control how direct the message sounds. Frankly and honestly signal a direct view, whereas apparently and perhaps make a statement more cautious.

sourceOmissions: English versions of Chinese-only Important Rules and Benefits headings are faithful editorial translations.

en: Rewrite each sentence by placing an appropriate sentence adverb after the complete subject. Use commas before and after the inserted adverb.
The first word of each answer has been provided.
